target.statement: Mean accuracy gain of Path-based Adaptive Weighting over standard RF (Δacc = +0.0026) on the 36-dataset benchmark
target.dataset: 36 UCI/OpenML binary classification benchmarks (e.g. hepatitis, wine, heart-disease, ...)

compute.basis: 36 datasets x 30 repeats x 300-tree RF plus 5-fold CV weight tables and 4 comparators (incl. deslib KNORA) is thousands of sklearn RF fits on small-to-medium tables; CPU-bound, hours on 8 cores.

blockers: 36 datasets x 30 repeats x 300 trees is a large number of RF fits; full protocol is hours not minutes
KNORA baselines need deslib and add runtime
exact +0.0026 mean requires reproducing all 36 datasets and 30 repeats
title: Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification
